veranderings.rede: 'X is wanneer' as a definition follows English 'X is when'; 'beteken dat' is the natural Afrikaans defining form and keeps the meaning.

veranderings.voor: is vacca, en daarvan kom ons woord vaksinasie.
veranderings.na: is 'vacca', en daarvan kom ons woord 'vaksinasie'.
veranderings.rede: Words cited as words are marked off with quotation marks, so the learner sees that the Latin word and the Afrikaans word are being named, not used; the protected word itself is unchanged.
